hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "cookwright doctor skipped, needs node, run setup"; exit 0; }; d=$PWD; until [ -f "$d/node_modules/cookwright/bin/cookwright.mjs" ] || [ "$d" = / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/node_modules/cookwright/bin/cookwright.mjs" ] || { echo "cookwright doctor skipped: package not installed (npm install)"; exit 0; }; node "$d/node_modules/cookwright/bin/cookwright.mjs" doctor --hook || echo "cookwright doctor crashed (exit $?)"
